title: how-it-works.md sends the reader to a 'Grid costs page' that does not exist
claim: docs/how-it-works.md (The DSO transfer fee; Capacity (effekt) tariffs) twice says to configure fees and the tariff month/hour/weekday masks 'on the Grid costs page'. The options menu has no such page: the masks are on 'Grid peak tariff' and the transfer fee on 'Advanced settings -> Transfer fees and contract'. The same section also calls the whole-house meter a 'baseline load entity', while the field is labelled 'Whole-house power meter'. A feature reader following how-it-works cannot find the page by its name.

evidence.contention_note: fan-out: other seats running concurrently; counts are contention-immune

instrumented_symbol: custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/translations/en.json:options.step.{init,advanced}.menu_options (the menu labels the options flow renders)
perturbation: --perturb renames the grid_fees menu label to 'Grid costs' in memory: missing_pages 1 -> 0 (executed).
metric_definition: Distinct '<Name> page' references in docs/how-it-works.md whose Name is not an options-menu label.
phenomenon_property: Every options page a reader doc names is named by its rendered menu label.
proposed_fix_scope: Docs only: name 'Grid peak tariff' and 'Advanced settings -> Transfer fees and contract'; call the meter 'Whole-house power meter'.
